Class Review

java.lang.Object
foodreview.Review
public class Review extends Object
This is the main instantiable class type for the Food Review System application.

This class acts as a data object for carrying information between the View/Controller and the Model. It stores details including food names, ratings, categories, dates and other optional data.

    • Review

      public Review(int ID, String name, int rating, Category cat, String subtype, String location, LocalDate date)
      Constructs a new Review object with all required and optional data.
      Parameters:
      ID - The unique ID from the database.
      name - The name of the food item.
      rating - The int rating of the food item.
      cat - The Category enum value.
      subtype - The optional subtype of the food item, can be null
      location - The optional location of the review, can be null
      date - The LocalDate of the review.

  • Method Details

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Formats the review into a single string for easy data storage and sharing.

      This version is specifically designed to return a single review without labels, separated by '-'. This is used mainly to allow a review to easily be split into smaller strings, in cases such as the main menu's data table in ReviewSystem.

      Overrides:
      toString in class Object
      Returns:
      A dash-separated String of the data in the object.

    • consoleToString

      public String consoleToString()
      Formats the review data into a multi-line and user-friendly string.

      This method is meant for displaying the content of a review object in the console area of the ReviewSystem. It's formatted to display each data's label and ensure the date is easily readable for a user to understand.

      Returns:
      A formatted String for console output.
